name: Actions UI
description: Allows configuration of tasks to be executed in response to events.
notes: Contrib continuation of Drupal core's former 'Actions UI' (action) module, which was removed from core. The `action` config entity type itself is still defined by core's System module (Drupal\system\Entity\Action); this module supplies the admin UI (list builder, add/edit/delete forms via hook_entity_type_build) at /admin/config/system/actions plus three configurable 'advanced' action plugins and D6/D7 migration support. Pre-1.0 release (0.2.2).
project_description:
The Actions UI module that up until Drupal 11 was part of Drupal core

 Features 
 Actions are module-defined tasks that can be executed on the site; for example, unpublishing content, sending an email message, or blocking a user.

 In the core software, actions can be executed through a bulk operations form added to a view; if you have the core Views module installed, see the related help topic "Managing content listings (views)" for more information about views and bulk operations.

 Post-Installation 
 Advanced actions require configuration. Before they are available for listing and execution, they need to be created and configured. For example, for an action that sends email, you would need to configure the email address.

 Additional Requirements 
 No dependencies, usable with Drupal 10.3+
